documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment of ESOP / ESPS
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Marksans Pharma reported its strongest-ever quarterly performance for Q2FY27, with revenue reaching ₹940 crore, up 30.5% YoY, and EBITDA growing 48.3% to ₹214 crore. Growth was broad-based across geographies like the UK & Europe, Australia & New Zealand, and US & North America. The company maintained a strong net cash position of ₹1,095 crore and robust operating cash generation, supported by ongoing strategic acquisitions and new product rollouts. Marksans Pharma reported a strong start to FY27 with Q1 operating revenue of INR840.8 crores, up 35.6% year-on-year, and record-high quarterly EBITDA and PAT. Growth was supported by strong performances across major regions, particularly Europe and the UK, alongside recent acquisitions like QliniQ and ABCnow.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue for QliniQ to be around INR150 crores to INR175 crores overall for the year.
guidance.quote: We expect QliniQ will do around INR150 crores to INR175 crores in terms of the revenue overall for the year.

guidance.claim: Management anticipates Europe's revenue to be around INR180 crores.
guidance.quote: So we do expect Europe to be somewhere around INR180 crores to -- yes, about INR180 crores. You can put it at INR180 crores.

guidance.claim: The company remains on target to hit INR4,000 crores within the next two years.
guidance.quote: We do anticipate us -- I mean, we are still very much on our target of hitting INR4,000 crores within the next two years.

guidance.claim: Management projects a gross margin around 55% to 56% for the year.
guidance.quote: And yes, in terms of sustainability of that 25-odd percent -- yes, 59%, I think we should be around 55%, 56% gross margin per se.

guidance.claim: An EBITDA margin of 21% to 22% is stated as achievable by the end of the year.
guidance.quote: End of the year, 21% to 22% is achievable. Yes.

guidance.claim: Management projects that the European geography can reach about INR1,000 crores within five years.
guidance.quote: In the next three to five years, let’s say, more or less within five years, we are hoping that that geography can do about INR1,000-odd crores.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the order book remains strong despite a softer US consumer environment.
demand_outlook.quote: Order book remains strong despite a softer US consumer environment, supporting the outlook for H2FY27

demand_outlook.claim: Management reported that RoW revenue declined amidst the West Asia crisis and geopolitical stabilization could support recovery.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue declined 47.0% YoY and 29.6% QoQ, amidst the West Asia crisis. • Middle East shipments impacted; stabilization in geopolitical conditions could support recovery in the quarters to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Price erosion in the Rx portfolio remained in single digits.
demand_outlook.quote: Price erosion in our Rx portfolio remained in single digits, and in the coming quarters, we expect momentum to strengthen.

demand_outlook.claim: The underlying business in Australia and New Zealand remains healthy.
demand_outlook.quote: The underlying business remains healthy, and we expect momentum to build as we move through the year.

demand_outlook.claim: The order book remains strong for the U.S. business.
demand_outlook.quote: Well, we do see -- the order book is still strong. So that's not a problem.

demand_outlook.claim: Markets outside of western regions are experiencing challenges due to war scenarios and transportation hurdles.
demand_outlook.quote: Obviously, the other markets besides the western markets are struggling a bit because of the war scenarios, because of vessels unable to pass and the transportation becoming one of the biggest hurdles in those regions.

capex_expansion.claim: Management reported a capex spend of ₹46 crore in H1FY27.
During the quarter, the company completed the acquisition of QliniQ B.V in the Netherlands.
capex_expansion.quote: During the quarter, we completed the acquisition of QliniQ B.V in Netherlands, which contributed approximately INR44 crores of revenue in Q1.

capex_expansion.claim: The acquisition of ABCnow GmbH in Germany was completed with consolidation commencing from Q2.
capex_expansion.quote: We then completed the acquisition of ABCnow GmbH, Germany with consolidation commencing from Q2.

capex_expansion.claim: Marksans Pharma Europe has been established in Ireland and Marksans Pharma GmbH in Germany.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside these acquisitions, we have established Marksans Pharma Europe in Ireland and Marksans Pharma GmbH in Germany.

capex_expansion.claim: Net capex for the quarter stood at INR33 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: After net capex of INR33 crores, free cash flow stood at INR152 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Gross profit for Q1 FY27 stood at INR497.3 crores, with the gross margin improving to 59.1%.
margins_costs.quote: Gross profit stood at INR497.3 crores, up 38.9% year-on-year from INR358.2 crores. While gross margin improved to 59.1% from 57.8%, an expansion of 138 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: R&D spend for the quarter was INR23.2 crores, representing 2.8% of consolidated revenue.
margins_costs.quote: R&D spend for the quarter was INR23.2 crores or 2.8% of consolidated revenue compared with INR12.1 crores and 2% in Q1 of FY2026.

orders_capacity.claim: The Goa Teva facility is progressing towards an INR80 crores revenue generation target from that plant and is currently at INR50-plus crores.
orders_capacity.quote: The Teva facility is progressing. We had projected about moving towards an INR80 crores revenue generation from that plant. We are right now at INR50-plus crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that H1 operating cash flow reached ₹322 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: H1 operating cash flow reaching ₹322 crore, 4.3 times the previous year, and cash balances closing at ₹1,124 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated INR185 crores of cash from operations during the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: We generated INR185 crores of cash from operations during the quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Free cash flow for the quarter stood at INR152 crores after net capex.
capital_allocation.quote: After net capex of INR33 crores, free cash flow stood at INR152 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company ended the quarter with a cash balance of INR1,058 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We ended the quarter with a cash balance of INR1,058 crores compared with INR711 crores at the end of Q1 FY2026.

capital_allocation.claim: Net cash stood at INR1,031 crores at the end of the quarter.
capital_allocation.quote: While the net cash stood at INR1,031 crores, this was achieved despite the payment towards the QliniQ acquisition during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that Middle East shipments were impacted amid the West Asia crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: Revenue declined 47.0% YoY and 29.6% QoQ, amidst the West Asia crisis. • Middle East shipments impacted

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical uncertainties are cited as prevailing risks surrounding countries.
risks_headwinds.quote: So we do foresee that due to the continuance of this geopolitical uncertainties, I think what we projected historically or before, we stand by that.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to file over 200 products in the UK over the next 4 years.
Management aims to expand Indian capacity to 16 billion units per annum.
management_commitments.quote: Aim to expand Indian capacity to 16bn units p.a.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to hit INR4,000 crores within the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We do anticipate us -- I mean, we are still very much on our target of hitting INR4,000 crores within the next two years.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to double its product portfolio in every country within the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: And we have taken this objective in the next two to three years to literally double our portfolio in every country that we are in.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
